card.thesis: Round 45 cell on the taxable trading book: base `kim` (persona: Creator E (creator-e)), entry 'close crosses_above bb_mid(20, 2) and rsi(14) > rsi_at_swing_high(14, 10)', exit 'close crosses_below bb_mid(20, 2)', stop 0.12, take-profit None, hold cap 150, 6 slots at 0.125 each. This base is a MEASURED card (`r40-rsi-confirm-slots6`), not a vault draft, and carries no `published`/fidelity caveat of its own -- round 40 already found it inside the 21.2pp floor. Arm `trim115`, borrowed from Creator B (wsaj)'s trim-after-exceptional-gains discipline: exit becomes 'close crosses_below bb_mid(20, 2) or close > sma(200) * 1.15' -- the base exit plus 'or close > sma(200) * 1.15', nothing else changed. Predicted to lower exposure and lose to the base in bull-2024 and recent (r44's trim arm: +0.4 to +2.4pp, null). Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any measurement (see strategy-program/ROUND-45-PLAN.md and strategy-program/MIX-AND-MATCH-PLAN.md section 3). Nothing here is promotable -- the `trading` purpose is exempt from PROTOCOL.md section 6 promotion (r21 amendment); this is a measurement study, report only. Not investment advice.
card.falsification: Honest prior: the null (rounds 17/18/34/38/39/40/42 put form, exit, rotation, style tilts and confirmation conjuncts all inside the 21.2pp floor). Decision rule: an enhancement earns something only if its marginal -- the mean over its bases of (arm median adjusted excess minus base median) -- exceeds the floor AND its arm cells survive BH q<0.10 over m=14 (each arm cell contrasted with its own base; base cells carry p=None but count in m). Pre-registered predictions: (1) null for all four enhancements. (2) `trend100` cuts trades vs base on both bases it applies to (kim, wsaj). (3) `rr5` cells are nearly identical to their base -- fewer than 10% of exits are expected to be the take-profit target, counted from the run files' trade logs. (4) `risk1pct` lowers mean exposure and raises adjusted excess per unit exposure without changing sign patterns across windows. (5) `trim115` lowers exposure and loses to base in bull-2024 and recent. Nothing here is promotable regardless of outcome (`trading` purpose, PROTOCOL.md r21 amendment). Sign flips by regime are expected; only the eight-window median is safe to read.
